title: Slime Mold
description: A Physarum polycephalum plasmodium grown from an agent model: tens of thousands of virtual protoplasm streams each sniff the trail ahead (left / centre / right), steer toward the strongest scent and lay their own trail, which diffuses and evaporates. Inoculated at the bottom, the colonised region advances outward as a fan — a fine green foraging mesh sweeps across the dish and a dense reticulated vein web (loops, anastomosis, never settling) consolidates behind the margin. A vein-sharpening feedback pulls flux into the strong routes so thick golden transport trunks fan out from the source and taper to fine twigs, and the render lights it as a real plasmodium: green at the advancing mesh, gold along the tubes, a wet cream sheen down the biggest trunks, all glowing over dark agar; beats surge the fan forward. Click to drop an oat flake the colony reaches toward and consumes. Fan advance, density, sensing, vein sharpening, sheen and glow are all live and audio-mappable.
